verdict.rationale: Unleash documents automated rollout processes (release templates with automatic milestone progression). It also documents change requests, which require approval, up to 10 approvers, before changes apply in an environment, so the review part is covered. Versioning and rollback of the automation definitions themselves are not documented: the 'roll back quickly' language refers to rolling back a released feature, and audit logs are only adjacent to version history. Missing for 10: explicit version history for release templates or automated rollouts, a documented rollback-to-prior-version of automation configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: you can define a reusable, structured rollout process that progresses automatically while monitoring application health
Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.
You can require up to 10 approvals for a change request.
